newsitem.title: TURKMENISTAN: Turkmenistan expects $66 mln in World Bank loans.
newsitem.headline: Turkmenistan expects $66 mln in World Bank loans.

text.p: The World Bank is expected to grant Turkmenistan two loans worth a total of $66 million in the coming months, a report from the press service of the Turkmen president said on Thursday.
A $31 million loan is being earmarked to finance a project to provide drinking water for the Tashauz region, which is severely affected by the drying up of the Aral Sea.
Another $35 million loan will be used to develop passenger transport in the capital Ashgabat.
The World Bank is expected to approve the loans at a board meeting in April.
A press service official said the loans could be granted for a period of up 20 years.
